races.title: Moment For The Monastery Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Not the easiest race to assess but REALTA LIATH has a good record fresh and is also well handicapped on her Fontwell chasing debut win so gets the vote. Chasing newcomers Livingonaprayer and Crazierthandaisy bring potential and are in excellent hands so could emerge as the main dangers, especially if the betting speaks in their favour. REALTA LIATH (IRE) LIVINGONAPRAYER CRAZIERTHANDAISY

races.title: Prancing To The Pilsner Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: NORTH OF RICHMOND put a disappointing handicap debut behind him when scoring at Newcastle on his reappearance and it's reasonable to assume he could have further improvement in the pipeline given his lightly-raced profile, so a 2 lb higher mark looks well within his compass. Virtual Rock is thriving for his current yard and shouldn't be inconvenienced by the return to 2m given how he goes through his races, with Caelan completing the shortlist. NORTH OF RICHMOND (IRE) VIRTUAL ROCK (IRE) CAELAN (IRE)

races.title: Podkovan Zero To Hero Handicap Chase
races.verdict: CHOSEN HERO , like many before her, was much improved for the switch to James Owen when a comfortable hurdles scorer at Lingfield recently and is taken to follow up reverted to fences off a still handy-looking mark. Walk The Plank has been in excellent nick since the cheekpieces went on and rates the main danger, although course specialist Cloudy Wednesday and C&D scorer Helios Allen can also play a prominent role. CHOSEN HERO (IRE) WALK THE PLANK (IRE) CLOUDY WEDNESDAY (IRE)

races.title: Podkovans Last Orders 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Newcomer TOOK YOU TWO makes appeal on breeding for this type of race, so he’s put forward as the suggestion before market clues. Nostrae De Cougny quickened well to account for Annies Pass on his debut at Market Rasen and could uphold the form under a penalty. Snicket wasn’t seen to best effect in a muddling race over C&D last month and is also considered. TOOK YOU TWO NOSTRAE DE COUGNY (FR) ANNIES PASS
